aura.privacy.body:
Dolmadang Soft (the "Company") values the personal information of users of the Aura app service and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act. This policy applies only to the Aura app service.

1. Personal Information Collected and Purposes

ItemCategoryDetailsNotes
Face Reading & Palmistry AnalysisNot logged in (free)Face and hand images (processed on-device; uploaded only when saved)Analysis is processed on the device only
Logged in (saving results)Email, display name (provided by Google/Kakao OAuth), analysis result text, landmark coordinatesStored in Supabase
Error inquiries-Email addressFor handling inquiries
On-Device Processing Notice: The original images used for face-reading and palmistry analysis are not transmitted to any server. Analysis is performed only on the user's device through Google Gemma on-device AI.

2. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information

We retain personal information in order to save analysis results, and we destroy it without delay upon membership withdrawal. Where retention is required by law, we retain the information for the periods below.

  • Records on display and advertising: 6 months (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
  • Records on contracts or withdrawal of subscription: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)
  • Records on payment and supply of goods: 5 years (Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce)

3. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties

The Company does not provide personal information to third parties without the user's consent or a legal basis. Exceptions apply only in unavoidable cases, such as a request from an investigative agency pursuant to law.

4. Entrustment of Personal Information Processing

CategoryTrusteeEntrusted Task
AuthenticationGoogle LLCGoogle OAuth social login
AuthenticationKakao Corp.Kakao OAuth social login
DatabaseSupabase, Inc.Storage of member information and analysis results
PaymentToss PaymentsPayment processing for paid content

5. Rights of the Data Subject

Users may at any time request to (1) access, (2) correct, (3) delete, or (4) suspend the processing of their personal information. To request account deletion and data deletion, please use the Account Deletion Request page or contact us at the email address below.

6. Destruction of Personal Information

After the purpose has been achieved, the information of users who are not logged in is destroyed immediately, and the information of logged-in users is destroyed after membership withdrawal once any retention period required by relevant law has elapsed. Electronic files are deleted in a manner that makes recovery impossible.

7. Measures to Ensure Security

We take measures to protect personal information through the principle of on-device processing without transmitting original images to a server, social OAuth-based account management, and Supabase's encrypted storage policies.

8. Personal Information Protection Officer

Name: Jung Song-yeop  |  Position: CEO

Email: admin@taoist.co.kr

9. Revision History

aura.terms.body:
These Terms govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between Dolmadang Soft (the "Company") and users regarding the use of the Aura app service (the "Service") provided by the Company.

Chapter 1 General Provisions

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Terms is to set out the various matters between the Company and users regarding the use of the Aura app service.

Article 2 (Definitions) A "Member" means a person who agrees to these Terms and uses the Service, and "Content" means the AI face-reading and palmistry analysis results provided by the Company.

Article 3 (Effect and Amendment of Terms) These Terms take effect upon notice within the app. Material changes are announced 30 days before they take effect, and other changes are announced 7 days in advance.

Chapter 2 Rights and Obligations of Members

Article 4 (Rights of Members) Members may freely use the Service and have the right to have their personal information and content protected.

Article 5 (Obligations of Members) Members must securely manage their account information and must not engage in the following acts.

  • Illegal acts using the Service
  • Unauthorized collection or use of others' personal information
  • Interference with the normal operation of the Service
  • Defamation of the Company or violation of laws

Chapter 3 Use of the Service

Article 6 (Service Content) The Company provides the following services.

  • AI face-reading and palmistry analysis content (on-device processing)
  • Personalized analysis information
  • Saving and viewing analysis results (logged-in members)

Article 7 (Restriction of Service Use) The Company may restrict or suspend all or part of the Service in the event of system maintenance, violation of laws, or a Member's breach of obligations.

Chapter 4 Cancellation, Termination, and Refunds

Article 8 (Termination of Contract) Members may terminate their Service use agreement at any time by deleting their account. Upon account deletion, all data is permanently deleted.

Article 9 (Refund Policy)

  • Content not yet viewed: full refund within 7 days of purchase
  • After content has been viewed: withdrawal of subscription is restricted under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce
  • When the Service is not provided: full refund

Refund requests: help@taoist.co.kr (processed within 3 business days of receipt)

Chapter 5 Disclaimers

⚠️ Important Notice Regarding the Nature of Analysis Results The AI face-reading and palmistry analysis results provided by this app are entertainment content based on traditional face reading and palmistry, and are not medical, legal, or financial advice. Please do not use the analysis results as a basis for important decisions, and treat them for reference only.

The Company is not responsible for service interruptions caused by force majeure, such as natural disasters or system failures.

Chapter 6 Miscellaneous

Article 10 (Governing Law and Dispute Resolution) These Terms are interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Korea, and in the event of a dispute, the court with jurisdiction over the location of the Company's head office shall be the court of first instance.

aura.support.q1: Are my photos stored on a server?
aura.support.a1: No. The original face and hand images used for face-reading and palmistry analysis are not transmitted to a server. All image analysis is processed only on your device through Google Gemma on-device AI. Only when you choose to save your results are the analysis result text and landmark coordinate data stored in Supabase.
aura.support.q2: Do I have to log in to save my results?
aura.support.a2: Yes. The ability to save analysis results and view them again later is available only to members who have logged in with a Google or Kakao account. The analysis feature itself can be used for free without logging in.
aura.support.q3: Can I view my analysis history on other devices?
aura.support.a3: Yes. Analysis results for logged-in members are stored on the Supabase server, so you can view them on other devices as long as you sign in with the same account.
aura.support.q4: Why is the AI model so large? It takes a while to download.
aura.support.a4: Because the on-device AI (Google Gemma) runs directly on your device, an initial model file download (about 1–2GB) is required. After that, analysis runs quickly without any server connection, and once downloaded, you can use the analysis even while offline.
aura.support.a5: Aura's face-reading and palmistry results are entertainment content based on traditional physiognomy and palmistry. Please do not use them as a basis for medical, legal, or financial decisions, and use them for fun and reference only.
aura.support.q6: What happens if I delete my account?
aura.support.a6: When you delete your account, all analysis results, profile information, and OAuth connection details stored in Supabase are permanently deleted. Deleted data cannot be recovered, so please decide carefully. Requests are processed within 7 business days.
aura.support.q7: Why do you need camera permission?
aura.support.a7: Camera or photo access permission is required to capture your face in real time during face-reading analysis or to select a photo from your gallery. The permission is only activated when you use the analysis feature, and captured images are never transmitted off your device.
